turns.user: My knee is still sore. Should I get knee surgery?
turns.reply: I can’t advise whether knee surgery is right for you. Please speak with your GP, who can discuss your options. I can also explain what Essential Plus covers for knee surgery if you’d like.

turns.user: If I do, what's the excess on my plan?
turns.reply: I can’t confirm an excess because the plan documents available to me don’t specify one. They list a €1,500 limit per day-case procedure (up to two per policy year); inpatient stays are assessed individually, so check your member portal for the amount that would apply and any pre-authorisation details.
